description.value: Sushi House is a Japanese and Asian restaurant situated on Lougheed Highway in Pitt Meadows, preparing sushi and other dishes from fresh ingredients. It sits along a major cycling corridor through the Fraser Valley, making it a practical dine-in or takeout stop for riders passing through the area. Online ordering is available for those wanting to plan ahead.
